interpretation.coverage_level: Qualitative scope assessment of the subsystem formalized in this repository; never a percentage of the corresponding mathematical field.
interpretation.basic_theory: If true, eligible for the compact A, B, C, ... foundation list in the paper.
interpretation.module_map: Every compiler-reached project module is assigned exactly once by the checked-in exact module map; no regex classification is used in the generated evidence.

coverage_levels.focused_reusable_slice: A reusable but deliberately narrow interface/construction slice.
coverage_levels.substantial_focused_subsystem: Multiple mutually supporting definitions/results around a focused mathematical topic.
coverage_levels.substantial_reusable_subsystem: A coherent reusable subsystem with significant results independent of the final source theorem wrappers.
coverage_levels.broad_partial_development: Broad coverage across several aspects of the topic, with no claim of field-level completeness.
coverage_levels.source_specific_development: Formalization specific to assembling, translating, or auditing the target source results.

theories.label: Hilbert-space subspaces, projections, and principal angles
theories.scope_note: Reusable projection/subspace geometry, principal-angle and sine-angle interfaces, aligned bases, and finite-frame structure.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Singular values, Gram operators, and singular-subspace geometry
theories.scope_note: Reusable rectangular/singular-value and Gram-operator infrastructure supporting the YWS development.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Spectral gaps, spectral subspaces, and variational eigenvalue arguments
theories.scope_note: A focused reusable slice for spectral ordering, eigenframes, gap hypotheses, and finite-dimensional spectral-subspace reasoning.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Unitarily invariant norms and operator ideals
theories.scope_note: A broad partial development covering UIN seminorms, symmetric-gauge/majorization interfaces, approximation numbers, and Ky Fan/Schatten/Hilbert--Schmidt style machinery.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Projection-valued measures and Borel spectral calculus
theories.scope_note: A coherent reusable bounded Borel functional-calculus/PVM subsystem, including spectral-projection constructions.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Closed and unbounded self-adjoint spectral theory
theories.scope_note: A broad partial development of closed operators, resolvents, spectral measures/restrictions, and related self-adjoint spectral infrastructure required by the infinite-dimensional DK results.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Real/complex Hilbert-space transfer
theories.scope_note: Reusable complexification, spectral transfer, and descent machinery allowing source results to be stated over real Hilbert spaces while using complex spectral tools internally.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Polar decomposition, direct rotations, and two-projection geometry
theories.scope_note: A broad partial development around polar decomposition, partial isometries, direct rotations, Halmos two-projection geometry, nonacute configurations, and classification/realization tools.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Operator angles and double-angle geometry
theories.scope_note: A focused but substantial theory of operator angles, tangent/sine transforms, reflections, and double-angle constructions used by Parts II--III.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Sylvester equations and separated intertwiners
theories.scope_note: A substantial focused subsystem for Sylvester equations, spectral separation, and operator-equation estimates.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.

theories.label: Residual, Ritz, and compression geometry
theories.scope_note: Reusable residual and Ritz-compression identities connecting approximate invariant subspaces to angle bounds.
theories.known_omissions: Not a claim of completeness for the mathematical field; refine after theory-specific audit.
